notes: Actual root cause of the empty Assignment tab found and fixed. The backend's local-bundle-list function file existed but was never imported in the startup index, so Azure Functions never registered the /local/license/bundles route. Every fetchBundles call has been returning HTTP 404 since the file was first added — the portal swallowed it as bundles=[] and the Assignment tab stayed empty regardless of what was in storage. One missing import. Assignment tab should now finally surface the Assign dropdowns
